=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh:223-230 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the close_failed branch, the best-effort `ai:closed` rollback at line 228 (`gh_retry gh issue edit ... --remove-label 'ai:closed' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true`) throws away its own failure, so if both the close and the rollback fail, the issue stays open with `ai:closed`, the blocked handler then adds `ai:blocked`, and nothing records the inconsistent state (`close_failed` is reported either way).
  WHY: orchestrate_lib.py:1515-1523 ranks `ai:closed` above `ai:blocked` in PHASE_LABELS_PRIORITY, and orchestrate_lib.py:2435-2438 returns "closed" for an open issue that has `ai:closed`, so the orchestrator treats a blocked issue as finished. All flagging reviewers rated this MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged the same path (it needs two consecutive failures after gh_retry) to be a hardening item, not a defect, and noted the last run reduced the risk.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2611-2616 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The "Handle blocked planning output" label transition adds `ai:blocked` and removes ai:planning/ai:clarification/ai:awaiting-approval, but never removes a stale `ai:closed`, so the script's best-effort rollback is the only thing that clears it.
  WHY: When the script's rollback fails, the open issue keeps both labels and the orchestrator resolves it as "closed". This is rated MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash proposes adding `--remove-label 'ai:closed'` to this edit. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 warns that this would be a regression: in repos with no `ai:closed` label, `gh issue edit` fails on the unknown label, `|| true` hides the failure, and `ai:blocked` would never be added.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:Handle blocked planning output step (lines 2666-2675 in patch) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The blocked handler does not remove the 'ai:closed' label when an issue has been previously closed unsuccessfully.
  WHY: If the script fails both to close the issue and to remove 'ai:closed', the issue stays open with 'ai:closed' plus 'ai:blocked', and the orchestrator treats 'ai:closed' as a finished issue. This is rated MAJOR. It is likely the same step as the plan.yml:2611-2616 entry, but the patch-relative line range does not overlap, so it is not merged.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:Verify nothing-to-implement block step | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The step does not pass PLAN_PROGRESS_COMMENT_ID to scripts/plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh, so the progress comment is never deleted when the issue is closed.
  WHY: The helper expects the progress comment ID in its environment. This is rated MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash both reject it: plan.yml:1910 exports PLAN_PROGRESS_COMMENT_ID via `$GITHUB_ENV` in the earlier "Post progress signal" step (plan.yml:1898-1913), so later steps receive it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Keep workflow files under the 480,000-byte guard" (linked issue, Acceptance section).
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml (grown +51 lines by this PR) and the guard test tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR's own acceptance table marks `tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py` as "unmet", and the pre-push gate lists it as an inherited failure that also fails on the merge-base. Per tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py:44-59, that means some workflow file is at or above 480,000 bytes. The PR adds about 51 lines to plan.yml (now 4,355 lines) instead of shrinking inline bodies. Exact byte sizes were not measured. The reviewer rated it NIT and notes the failure is inherited, likely from implement.yml (7,618 lines). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 likewise states this PR did not cause it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- scripts/plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh:line 228, the close_failed branch (`gh_retry gh issue edit ... --remove-label 'ai:closed' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true`) | HARDENING_SUGGESTION | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: If the rollback edit also fails, nothing records it. The open issue keeps `ai:closed`, and the blocked handler at plan.yml:2612-2616 adds `ai:blocked` without removing `ai:closed`. The orchestrate_lib.py precedence was not confirmed by this reviewer.
  WHY: Suggested fix (3-4 lines): record the rollback result; on failure use the detail `close_failed_label_stale` (allowed by the pnti_finish `[a-z_]` filter) and add it to the agents.d fragment. Do not add `--remove-label 'ai:closed'` to the shared blocked-handler edit at plan.yml:2612-2616: in repos without an `ai:closed` label the edit fails, `|| true` hides the failure, and `ai:blocked` would never be added.
- Rejected pass-1 claims (2 related items): PLAN_PROGRESS_COMMENT_ID not passed is not a defect, because plan.yml:1910 writes it to GITHUB_ENV (ISSUE_META_FILE plan.yml:977 and CODEX_OUTPUT_FILE plan.yml:981 work the same way). The concurrent-close rollback race was not reported because nothing in the code path shows such a close.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Every Phase 8a file listed in docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md (lines 474-482) has a matching diff hunk. The unmet test_plan_blocked_wait_on_pr.py and test_workflow_file_size_limit.py also fail on the merge-base. Phase 8b is out of scope.

  WHY: orchestrate_lib.py:1515-1523 lists `ai:closed` before `ai:blocked` in PHASE_LABELS_PRIORITY, and orchestrate_lib.py:2437-2438 returns "closed" before any blocked check, so the issue is treated as finished while the comment trail says "the block stays".
- scripts/plan_nothing_to_implement_verify.sh:lines 224-229 (post-fix close_failed branch) and .github/workflows/plan.yml:2612-2616 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  WHY: Nothing signals that the open issue is in the inconsistent state and nothing retries the cleanup, so everyone relies on the best-effort `|| true` succeeding.
